title: Make Updates Faster: A Fast Multi-Stripe Updates Framework in Erasure-Coded Storage Clusters
problem: Erasure coding introduces high update penalties due to read-modify-write overhead; existing schemes don't fully exploit locality or adapt to heterogeneous network conditions.
motivation: Erasure-coded storage reduces redundancy but update costs are high; data center workloads have clustered updates; dynamic network conditions require adaptive scheduling.
method: Three-part framework: (1) Locality-aware update merging reduces network traffic by coalescing requests to same stripe, (2) Abstract update schemes into collector selection + tree construction, greedily balance load, (3) Dynamic scheduling adapts to heterogeneous network bandwidth.
key_novelty: First framework to jointly optimize locality exploitation, load balancing, and dynamic scheduling for erasure-coded updates; 16–88% throughput gains.
contributions: Greedy load-balanced collector and tree selection
Dynamic stripe scheduling for bandwidth saturation
limitations: Evaluation limited to Alibaba environment; generalization to other systems unclear; dynamic scheduling overhead not detailed; real-world trace analysis limited.
